feats.name: Alert
feats.description: You gain a bonus to initiative rolls equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can't be surprised while you are conscious. Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

feats.name: Tough
feats.description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

feats.name: Musician
feats.description: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice. Furthermore, after you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can give Heroic Inspiration to a number of allies equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Crafter
feats.description: You gain proficiency with three Artisan's Tools of your choice. Furthermore, you receive a 20 percent discount on nonmagical items you buy.

feats.name: Healer
feats.description: When you use a Healer's Kit to stabilize a creature, they regain 1 HP. When you restore HP with a spell or Healer's Kit, you can reroll a 1 on a die.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can spend them to gain Advantage on a roll or impose Disadvantage on an attack against you.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a Melee weapon, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.
